name: Nohara Holiday Park
description: Nohara Holiday Park is a calm, booking-led WordPress theme for a touring caravan site with timber lodges. A film-grain photograph of the grounds takes the left of the first screen beside a large serif headline; a three-column stay ledger with its title straddling a pale band, a sticky narrative, caption-panel cards with a square olive badge, ruled booking rows and one olive booking pill with a book-direct disc carry the home page. Newsreader for headings, Nunito Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce.
